title: Knowledge
description: Each agent has its own memory. Detached memories remain available for rebinding.
name: Space name
emptyDescription: Bind a space to extract reusable experience when an issue reaches Done.
notConfigured: The knowledge service is not configured.
memberWait: Ask a workspace owner or admin to bind a knowledge space.
confirmUnbind: Detach this knowledge space? Existing knowledge stays in the space. Pending extraction jobs will be removed.
noExtractions: Completed issues will appear here when extraction starts.
memoryDescription: Each agent has its own memory. Detached memories remain available for rebinding.
memoryDetached: No memory is bound. Extraction and recall are paused.
changeMemoryDescription: Choose an unbound memory. Existing content stays in its original memory.

deleteMemoryDescription: Permanently delete “{{name}}” and its chat memory? The execution agent remains. Independent Skill, Wiki and CodeGraph assets remain managed in the native panel.
deleteBoundMemory: Also permanently delete the bound memory, if any
keepMemoryDescription: Leave unchecked to keep memory content and make it available for rebinding.
